scripts.check: npm run db:generate && npm run contracts:test && npm run check --workspace @skate-route-mapper/api
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @skate-route-mapper/api && npm run build --workspace @skate-route-mapper/admin
scripts.contracts:test: npm run contracts:test --workspace @skate-route-mapper/api && npm run contracts:test --workspace @skate-route-mapper/mobile
scripts.e2e: playwright install chromium && playwright test --config test/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:headed: playwright install chromium && playwright test --config test/playwright.config.ts --headed
